device.name: XIA PFCU-4 filter set and shutter controller

facts.text: PFCU is a PFCU-4 Filter Set & Relay Control Unit
The status parser reads four filter channels from the status report
set_filters accepts IN, I or 1 and OUT, O or 0 (case insensitive) per filter and '=' leaves a filter unchanged
filters_status decodes each channel as FilterStatus Out=0, In=1, OpenCircuit=2, ShortCircuit=3
The status report carries the identity line, four channel states, the RS232 control flags, the shutter mode and status, and the exposure decimation
The exposure conversion starts at decimation 1 and states that 65_535 is the maximum decimation
start_exposure converts seconds to an exposure count and a decimation, sends the decimation command and then the exposure command
close_shutter immediately closes the PF2S2 shutter and terminates an exposure in progress; close and open only work when shutter mode is enabled
enable_shutter enables the shutter commands and disable_shutter is the default condition at power-up
Requests are framed as !PFCU<module> <command>\r and replies start with %
The tango server opens the connection with eol=b';\r\n' and wraps PFCU with the configured module
The README exposes the serial line at 9600 baud
